issues.issue: Was the RPD's finding that Mr. Al-Fahham was complicit in crimes against humanity reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: RPD's findings were guilt by association; it never identified his significant contribution to the criminal purpose.
issues.respondent_position: Minister supported the complicity finding; the RPD agreed with its position (para 26).
issues.result_quote: I therefore conclude that Mr. Al-Fahham has not demonstrated that the RPD’s conclusion on complicity was unreasonable.

issues.issue: Were the RPD's adverse credibility findings reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Credibility findings cannot replace a significant-contribution finding, and the findings themselves were unreasonable.
issues.respondent_position: Minister said the RPD made no material credibility errors (para 44).
issues.result_quote: I agree with the Minister that the RPD did not make any material errors in assessing credibility that would justify this Court’s intervention.
